title: Wuppertal Schwebebahn 1902 & 2015 side by side video
summary: A side-by-side edit lining up footage of the Wuppertal Schwebebahn suspended monorail filmed in 1902 and in 2015. It lets you compare how the buildings and surroundings changed over 113 years.
why: HN shares it whenever the Wuppertal suspended railway comes up, as a neat then-and-now comparison.

quote.text: Here is a wonderful video, riding the Wuppertal Schwebebahn in 1902 and 2015 side by side
